headline: As of 2026-10-19: 10,003,519 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 40 of 50 states, D+18.7 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 10,003,519 early/mail ballots cast so far across 40 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+18.7 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,414,541), Florida (1,007,277), Georgia (862,756).
